2228-4279-4699.easyPrerequisites:
You control at least one additional creature.
Your life total is at least 2.
An opponent controls a creature.
2228-4279-4699.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing a creature, targeting any creature an opponent controls.
When the sacrificed creature dies, Overgrowth Elemental triggers, causing you to gain 1 life
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on a creature an opponent controls, and causing you to draw a card.
Hapatra triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat.
2228-4279-4699.notes: You may also repeat this loop whenever a creature enters the battlefield under an opponent's control. The lock will end once you've drawn your library.

2099-3682-5660-6769.easyPrerequisites:
You control at least one colored legendary creature or planeswalker.
Evolution Witness has a +1/+1 counter on it.
2099-3682-5660-6769.description:
Cast Mox Amber by paying its mana cost.
When Mox Amber enters, Surge Conductor triggers.
Holding priority, activate Mox Amber by tapping it, adding one mana of any color among legendary creatures and planeswalkers you control.
Activate Sarcatog by sacrificing Mox Amber, giving Sarcatog +1/+1 until end of turn.
Resolve the Surge Conductor trigger, causing you to proliferate, putting a +1/+1 counter on Evolution Witness.
Evolution Witness triggers, returning Mox Amber from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat

751-1322-3755.description:
Cast Shrieking Drake by paying {U}.
When Shrieking Drake enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Shrieking Drake by tapping it, adding {U}.
Resolve the Shrieking Drake ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

2301-4279-6559--216.easyPrerequisites:
The undying creature doesn't have a +1/+1 counter on it.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
2301-4279-6559--216.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing the undying creature.
When the creature dies, Venerated Stormsinger, Abzan Ascendancy and the undying creature's undying ability trigger.
Resolve the Venerated Stormsinger trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Abzan Ascendancy ability, creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on any creature and drawing a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Venerated Stormsinger triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life 
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on the undying creature and drawing a card.
Repeat.

147-653-2034.easyPrerequisites: There's a creature card in your graveyard.
147-653-2034.description:
Cast Fearsome Awakening by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Fearsome Awakening.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Fearsome Awakening
Resolve the Fearsome Awakening copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

522-2921--5.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing the creature with persist.
When that creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to Melira.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat.

997-2728-6012-7957.easyPrerequisites:
Genestealer Patriarch does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent controls a creature.
Rikku does not have summoning sickness.
997-2728-6012-7957.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two additional creatures.
997-2728-6012-7957.description:
Declare Genestealer Patriarch as an attacker.
Genestealer Patriarch's first ability triggers, putting an infection counter on a creature an opponent controls.
Activate Rikku's ability by paying its cost, moving the infection counter from the opponent's creature onto a creature you control.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing the creature with an infection counter on it.
When the creature dies, Reluctant Role Model and Genestealer Patriarch's second ability trigger.
Resolve the Reluctant Role Model trigger, putting an infection counter onto another creature you control.
Resolve the Genestealer Patriarch trigger, causing you to create a token copy of the sacrificed creature that is a Tyranid in addition to its other types.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat from step 4.

1594-1621-2350-6867.description:
Cast Appa either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {W}{W} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Appa enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Wispweaver Angel with the ability to cast it later from exile.
Cast Wispweaver Angel from exile by paying {0}.
Appa's second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token
When Wispweaver Angel enters, it triggers, blinking Appa.
Repeat from step 2.

232-2397-5778-6867.description:
Cast Priest of Urabrask by paying its mana cost plus an additional {2} for its offspring cost.
When Priest of Urabrask enters, it triggers twice and its offspring ability triggers twice due to Panharmonicon.
Resolve both innate Priest of Urabrask triggers, adding six {R}.
Resolve the first offspring trigger, creating a token copy of Priest of Urabrask that is 1/1.
When the Priest of Urabrask token enters, it triggers twice, adding six {R}.
Repeat steps 4 and 5 for the remaining offspring trigger.
Cast Appa by paying its mana cost plus an additional {2} for its offspring cost.
When Appa enters, it triggers twice and its offspring ability triggers twice.
Resolve both innate Appa triggers, airbending the nontoken Priest of Urabrask.
Resolve the first offspring trigger, creating a token copy of Appa that is 1/1.
Put the Appa token into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
The Appa token's enter-the-battlefield ability triggers, airbending nothing.
Resolve the second offspring trigger, creating a token copy of Appa that is 1/1.
Put the Appa token into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
The Appa token's enter-the-battlefield ability triggers, airbending the nontoken Appa.
Cast Priest of Urabrask from exile by paying {2} plus an additional {2} for its offspring cost.
Repeat steps 2 through 6 once.
Cast Appa from exile by paying {2} plus an additional {2} for its offspring cost.
Repeat from step 8.
232-2397-5778-6867.notes: Once you have extra mana, other nonland permanents can be airbended using Appa and returned to the battlefield each loop as desired.

1268-3809-4917-5184.easyPrerequisites: You control at least two other artifact creatures.
1268-3809-4917-5184.description:
Activate Jan Jansen's first ability by tapping it and sacrificing an artifact creature, creating three Treasure tokens due to Xorn.
Activate three Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {4}{U}{U} due to Goldspan Dragon.
Activate Crab Umbra by paying {2}{U}, untapping Jan Jansen.
Activate Jan Jansen's first ability by tapping it and sacrificing an artifact creature, creating three Treasure tokens due to Xorn.
Activate Crab Umbra by paying {2}{U}, untapping Jan Jansen.
Activate Jan Jansen's second ability by tapping it and sacrificing a Treasure, creating two 1/1 Construct artifact creature tokens.
Activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{U}{U} due to Goldspan Dragon.
Activate Crab Umbra by paying {2}{U}, untapping Jan Jansen.
Repeat.
1268-3809-4917-5184.notes: Once you have infinite mana and Treasure tokens, you can use Jan Jansen's second ability, paired with untapping it, infinitely to get infinite Construct tokens.

1765-2440-4720-7311.description:
Activate Improvised Arsenal by paying {4}{R}, creating a token copy of it.
Chishiro triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each creature you control that shares a creature type with the creature token.
If needed, activate Stonework Packbeast by paying {2}, adding {R}.
Repeat.
1765-2440-4720-7311.notes: The mana cost can be reduced if you control more creatures that share type(s) with the created tokens as the combo begins. You should perform step 4 only if you have no {R} in your mana pool. With infinite mana, the Improvised Arsenal tokens can be attached to creatures you control to make them infinitely large.

457-5159-5491-7175.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Mishra triggers, creating a token copy of Worldwalker Helm that is a 4/4 Construct artifact creature with haste named Mishra's Warform, and a Map token.
Activate Urza's first ability by tapping a Map, adding {U}.
Activate Mishra's Warform by paying {1}{U} and tapping it, creating a token copy of it and a Map token for each Mishra's Warform and/or Worldwalker Helm you control.
Activate Urza's first ability twice by tapping two Maps, adding {U}{U}.
Repeat from step 3.
457-5159-5491-7175.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may use it to activate Urza's ability.

414-2595-4613.easyPrerequisites: You control a creature that has a +1/+1 counter on it.
414-2595-4613.description:
Activate Combine Guildmage's first ability by paying {1}{G} and tapping it.
Activate a creature using Grist's first loyalty ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, causing you to create a 1/1 Insect creature token and mill a card, and then put a loyalty counter on the creature and repeat the process if the card was an Insect.
The Insect enters the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it due to Combine Guildmage, causing it to have Grist's abilities.
Repeat from step 2 using the Insect token instead.

1570-6786-7028.description:
Cast Sage of the Falls by paying {4}{U}.
When Sage of the Falls enters, it triggers, causing you to loot. The discarded card will be put on top of your library instead of into your graveyard due to Library of Leng.
Wan Shi Tong's second ability triggers, creating two 1/1 Spirit creature tokens.
When the Spirits enter, Sage of the Falls triggers twice.
Resolve the first trigger, choosing not to draw a card.
Resolve the second trigger, causing you to loot. The discarded card will be put on top of your library instead of into your graveyard due to Library of Leng.
Repeat from step 3.

2034-2835-3490-6783.easyPrerequisites: You have a card in hand.
2034-2835-3490-6783.description:
Activate Junk Golem by paying {1} and discarding a card, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
When the Servo dies, Fecundity triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat.

1818-2919-3197.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
1818-2919-3197.description:
Gain life.
Archangel of Thune triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Healer of the Pride triggers, causing you to gain 2 life.
Repeat from step 2.

4222-4549-6702.description:
Activate Relic of Legends' second ability by tapping Kilo, adding {U}.
Kilo triggers, causing you to proliferate.
Activate Freed from the Real by paying {U}, untapping Kilo.
Repeat.

1409-2933-5295-5798.easyPrerequisites: Deadeye Navigator paired with Drowner of Hope.
1409-2933-5295-5798.description:
Activate Drowner of Hope by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Drowner of Hope enters the battlefield, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger.
Resolve the Drowner of Hope trigger, creating two 1/1 Eldrazi Scion creature tokens.
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Drowner of Hope.
Activate an Eldrazi Scion by tapping it, adding {U}.
Activate an Eldrazi Scion by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.

1491-2033-3430-6218.easyPrerequisites: Sinking Feeling attached to Pheres-Band Tromper.
1491-2033-3430-6218.notablePrerequisites: Pheres-Band Tromper does not have summoning sickness.
1491-2033-3430-6218.description:
Activate Pheres-Band Tromper by tapping it, adding {G}{G}{G}.
Activate Pheres-Band Tromper by paying {1} and putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
Pheres-Band Tromper triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

1995-2060-6602.notablePrerequisites: You have had five nontoken creatures enter the battlefield under your control this turn.
1995-2060-6602.description:
Activate Tromell by paying {1} and tapping it, causing you to put at least five +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler
Activate Crystalline Crawler four times by removing five +1/+1 counters from it, adding {4}{W}.
Activate Gauntlets of Light by paying {2}{W}, untapping Tromell.
Repeat.

2511-3055-6553.easyPrerequisites: Gift of Immortality attached to Brotherhood Outcast.
2511-3055-6553.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Brotherhood Outcast.
When Brotherhood Outcast dies, Gift of Immortality triggers, returning Brotherhood Outcast from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Brotherhood Outcast enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Gift of Immortality from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Brotherhood Outcast.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat.

813-3603-4377.notablePrerequisites: You have enough mana available each turn to cast Walk the Aeons and Cloudshift.
813-3603-4377.description:
Cast Walk the Aeons by paying its mana cost, taking an extra turn.
Cast Cloudshift by paying its mana cost, blinking Scholar of the Ages.
When Scholar of the Ages enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Walk the Aeons and Cloudshift from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat each turn.

856-2034-2279-5776.description:
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food.
Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Cauldron Familiar and Quintorius trigger.
Resolve the Quintorius trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
When Cauldron Familiar dies, Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Repeat.

4853-4917-5056-6429.notablePrerequisites: An opponent controls four or more nonbasic lands.
4853-4917-5056-6429.description:
Activate Neurok Transmuter by paying {U}, causing Jan Jansen to become an artifact until end of turn.
Activate Jan Jansen's first ability by tapping it and sacrificing Razorlash Transmogrant.
When Razorlash Transmogrant dies, Dross Scorpion triggers, untapping Jan Jansen.
Resolve the Jan Jansen ability, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Activate Razorlash Transmogrant by paying {B}{B}, putting it from your graveyard onto the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.n: Emet-Selch, Unsundered // Hades, Sorcerer of Eld

4872-6333-6336.manaNeeded: {2} plus enough mana to cast the extra turn spell each turn
4872-6333-6336.description:
Cast Time Warp from your graveyard by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, activate Haystack by paying {2} and tapping it, phasing out Hades.
Resolve Time Warp, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
During your extra turn, Hades phases in during your untap step.
Repeat.

851-2793-3743-5089-5437.manaNeeded: {5} available, with an additional {5} every fourth turn
851-2793-3743-5089-5437.description:
Activate Osgir by paying {5}, tapping it and exiling Ugin's Nexus from your graveyard, creating four token copies of Ugin's Nexus.
Put three of the Ugin's Nexus tokens into exile due to the legend rule and their replacement effects, causing you to take three extra turns after this one.
Activate Karn's first loyalty ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, choosing to do nothing.
Move to your next extra turn.
Repeat from step 3 one additional time.
Activate Karn's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, returning Ugin's Nexus from exile to your hand.
Activate Prognostic Sphinx by discarding Ugin's Nexus.
Move to your last extra turn.
Repeat.

1247-4880-5963.notablePrerequisites: Marvin does not have summoning sickness.
1247-4880-5963.description:
Activate Marvin using Weaver of Currents's ability by tapping it, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Marvin using Pili-Pala's ability by paying {2} and untapping it, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat.

2061-3277-3617.notablePrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast Time Walk each turn.
2061-3277-3617.description:
Cast Time Walk by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your next turn.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Extravagant Replication triggers, creating a token copy of Izzet Chronarch.
When the Izzet Chronarch token enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Time Walk from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

3372-4050-4885-6006.manaNeeded: {1}{W} if Enduring Vitality is not a creature
3372-4050-4885-6006.description:
If Enduring Vitality is not a creature, activate Zur by paying {1}{W}, causing Enduring Vitality to become a creature.
Activate Enduring Vitality by tapping it, adding {W}.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Enduring Vitality, adding {1}.
When Enduring Vitality dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield as an enchantment.
Repeat.

2757-3356-4629.notablePrerequisites:
You have the highest life total.
You control at least one basic Mountain.
2757-3356-4629.description:
Activate a basic Mountain by tapping it, adding {R}.
Activate Pyrohemia by paying {R}, dealing 1 damage to each creature and each player.
Each Polyraptor you control triggers, creating that many token copies of Polyraptor.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping an untapped Polyraptor, untapping the basic Mountain.
Repeat.

215-1789-2499-5130.notablePrerequisites: You control an additional artifact, enchantment and/or token.
215-1789-2499-5130.description:
Cast Realm-Scorcher Hellkite by paying {4}{R}{R} and sacrificing another artifact, enchantment or token.
When Realm-Scorcher Hellkite enters the battlefield, it and Lathliss trigger twice.
Resolve both Realm-Scorcher Hellkite triggers, adding {5}{R}{R}{G}.
Resolve both Lathliss triggers, creating two 5/5 Dragon creature tokens.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Realm-Scorcher Hellkite to your hand from the battlefield.
Repeat.

719-2178-4170-4302.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one additional creature.
Thornbite Staff attached to Fain.
Fain does not have summoning sickness.
"Angel" chosen with Xenograft.
719-2178-4170-4302.description:
Activate Fain's first ability by tapping it and sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Bishop of Wings' second ability and Fain trigger.
Resolve the Bishop of Wings trigger, creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token.
When the Spirit enters the battlefield, Bishop of Wings' first ability triggers, causing you to gain 4 life.
Resolve the Fain trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Fain ability from step 1, putting two +1/+1 counters on a creature you control.
Repeat.

uses.n: Invasion of Segovia // Caetus, Sea Tyrant of Segovia

313-1170-1749-4113-4365.notablePrerequisites:
Sea Tyrant of Segovia.
You control at least one additional creature.
313-1170-1749-4113-4365.description:
Cast Corpse Dance with buyback by tapping Caetus, Vampire Hexmage and three other creatures you control.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Caetus and causing it to return to the battlefield as Invasion of Segovia.
When Invasion of Segovia enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating four 1/1 Kraken creature tokens.
Activate Vampire Hexmage by sacrificing it, removing all counters from Invasion of Segovia.
Invasion of Segovia triggers, causing you to exile it and cast it as Caetus, Sea Tyrant of Segovia.
Resolve Corpse Dance, returning Vampire Hexmage from your graveyard to the battlefield and returning Corpse Dance to your hand.
Repeat.

2232-2506-4188.notablePrerequisites:
"Elf" or "Druid" chosen with Molten Echoes.
You have gained at least five life this turn.
2232-2506-4188.description:
Cast Accomplished Alchemist by paying {3}{G}.
Accomplished Alchemist enters the battlefield, triggering Cloudstone Curio and Molten Echoes.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, choosing to return nothing to your hand.
Resolve the Molten Echoes trigger, creating a token copy of Accomplished Alchemist with haste.
The Accomplished Alchemist token enters the battlefield, triggering Cloudstone Curio, returning the nontoken Accomplished Alchemist from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate the Accomplished Alchemist token's second ability by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}{G}{G}.
Repeat.

648-3858.notablePrerequisites: Your library size is at least nineteen.
648-3858.description:
Cast Body of Research by paying {U}{U}{U}{G}{G}{G}, creating a 0/0 Fractal creature token and putting an amount of +1/+1 counters on it equal to your library size.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Mayael's Aria triggers, causing you to put a +1/+1 counter on the Fractal token, gain ten life, and win the game.

546-4499-4802.notablePrerequisites: Master Biomancer has a power of at least five.
546-4499-4802.description:
Activate Emiel by paying {3}, blinking Ramos and causing Ramos to enter with at least five +1/+1 counters on it due to Master Biomancer.
Activate Ramos by removing five +1/+1 counters from it, adding {W}{W}{U}{U}{B}{B}{R}{R}{G}{G}.
Repeat.

637-5173-5220-5231.description:
Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing Shambling Gast, adding {R}.
Mortuary, Shambling Ghast and Archghoul of Thraben trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Shambling Ghast on top of your library.
Resolve the Shambling Ghast trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Archghoul of Thraben trigger, revealing Shambling Ghast from the top of your library and putting it into your hand.
Activate the Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Cast Shambling Ghast by paying {B}.
Repeat.

583-1000-2103-2493.notablePrerequisites: {1} fewer mana required on the first turn if Mystic Reflection was foretold.
583-1000-2103-2493.description:
Cast Capture of Jingzhou by paying {3}{U}{U}, granting you an extra turn after this one.
Cast Mystic Reflection by paying {1}{U}, causing the next creatures or planeswalkers to enter the battlefield this turn to enter as copies of Archaeomancer.
Cast Sram's Expertise by paying {2}{W}{W}, creating three token copies of Archaeomancer and allowing you to cast a card with mana value 3 or less from your hand without paying its mana cost.
Each of the Archaeomancer's ETBs trigger, returning Mystic Reflection, Capture of Jingzhou, and Sram's Expertise to your hand.
Repeat.

1283-2397-3094-4404.description:
Cast Corridor Monitor for {2}.
With Corridor Monitor on the stack, use Lithoform Engine to copy the spell, using Chromatic Orrery to pay for Lithoform Engine.
Let the copy of Corridor Monitor resolve, triggering Corridor Monitor twice due to Panharmonicon, untapping Chromatic Orrery and Lithoform Engine.
Repeat steps 2-3.
